frames.observation: The complete authored chest, brass borders, teal panels, ivory teeth and wine tongue are readable in native combat idle at HP 58. The lid and lower body remain connected.
The native mimic attack carries the open authored chest forward with the lid, teeth and lower coffer still aligned. The foreground hero hides part of the tongue and lower body.
After dealing 14 hero damage, the authored model returns to a readable upright idle with the lid, tongue and lower panels coherent.
The ordinary no-focus hit resolves HP 58 to 52 during the native small-damage recoil. The authored lid and lower body remain attached behind strong hero and damage-effect occlusion.
The later native proficiency opens and tilts the coffer while the teeth, tongue, lid and base remain visually coherent.
The explicit KillSingle fixture reaches the native heavy-death animation as a closed coffer. The hero partly blocks the body, but the authored lid and base remain aligned.
The complete capture reaches the native Victory and item-choice surface with the closed coffer visible behind depth blur. This establishes the transition, not a precise corpse-lifetime interval.

conclusions.appearance: The authored coffer is recognizable and coherent at native scale through the reviewed idle, attack, hit, proficiency and death frames.
conclusions.idle: The complete pass capture contains cidle_mimic before and after the native attack with no visible part separation.
conclusions.attack: The complete pass capture contains attack_mimic and a causal native attack that deals 14 hero damage.
conclusions.hit: The complete ordinary no-focus attack capture contains damageSmall_mimic and records the same target at HP 58 to 52.
conclusions.death: The complete explicit KillSingle fixture contains deathHeavy_mimic. The renderer reports m_DoRagdoll false, so this is animated death rather than a body ragdoll.
conclusions.progression: The fresh process reaches native Loot after the fixture death. The prior V3 process separately supplies two guarded Collects, strict Ready and the next enemy room.

limits: The explicit KillSingle fixture is not ordinary lethal-damage evidence.
Hero, weapon, UI, depth blur and native effects obscure parts of several reviewed frames.
The selected frames do not prove every hinge or tongue interval, floor collision, sleeping, full culling, portrait or resource lifetime, final disposal, or finished-art acceptance.
The Victory frame does not establish a precise visible corpse lifetime.
